findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "devtools" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, markdown, scrape, llm, email_verify, transcribe, image_describe, sitemap, seo, gpt_oss_20b_chat_completions, gpt_oss_chat_completions · Private data: pdf, llm, llm_large, rpc, wallet, domain, document, rerank, ens, token_report, token_price, token_chart, defi_yields, company, devtools, ip, embeddings, images_generations, audio_transcriptions, audio_speech, token_solana, token_verdict, token_scan, chat_completions, qwen_chat_completions, gemma_chat_completions, glm_chat_completions, gpt_oss_20b_chat_completions, mistral_chat_completions, llama4_chat_completions, gpt_oss_chat_completions, coder_chat_completions, nemotron_chat_completions, large_chat_completions · Public sink: search, llm, email_verify, rpc, transcribe, speak, image_describe, document, ip, audio_transcriptions · Destructive: rerank, devtools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, markdown, scrape, llm, email_verify, transcribe, image_describe, sitemap, seo, gpt_oss_20b_chat_completions, gpt_oss_chat_completions · Private data: pdf, llm, llm_large, rpc, wallet, domain, document, rerank, ens, token_report, token_price, token_chart, defi_yields, company, devtools, ip, embeddings, images_generations, audio_transcriptions, audio_speech, token_solana, token_verdict, token_scan, chat_completions, qwen_chat_completions, gemma_chat_completions, glm_chat_completions, gpt_oss_20b_chat_completions, mistral_chat_completions, llama4_chat_completions, gpt_oss_chat_completions, coder_chat_completions, nemotron_chat_completions, large_chat_completions · Public sink: search, llm, email_verify, rpc, transcribe, speak, image_describe, document, ip, audio_transcriptions · Destructive: rerank, devtools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
